subject: ACE enrollment request — PDM/PSM pairing for CloudLeap co-sell
messages:
From: Amy Holt <amy.holt@cloudleap.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ACE registration ask + PDM/PSM pairing

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at CloudLeap is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the idea of offering our customers a jointly supported solution in the AWS channel. We'd like to start the AWS ACE enrollment and get a PDM/PSM pairing to coordinate the co-sell plan.

High-level:
- ARR expectation: $420k annualized in year 1 (initial target customers in fintech).
- AWS account ID: 987654321000
- Goal: complete ACE registration and have PDM/PSM intro by end of Feb so we can sync on co-sell materials and next steps.

Can you advise the exact ACE intake items you need from us and who at Redwood will be the PDM/PSM points of contact? I've copied our AE Raj Singh to loop him in.

Thanks,
Amy Holt
Sr. Partnerships Manager | CloudLeap Technologies
[Attachment: cloudleap-aws-account-info.xlsx (XLSX, 22KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Amy Holt <amy.holt@cloudleap.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACE registration ask + PDM/PSM pairing

Amy —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the account details. We should be able to move this through the ACE intake this week. Quick plan:

1) Karthik will kick off the ACE intake packet and confirm the AWS seller account match.
2) Vanessa (PDM) will be the primary co-sell lead for enablement and joint GTM assets.
3) I'll own the program coordination and the HubSpot/opportunity readiness on our side.

Karthik — can you share the ACE intake template and a short list of required artifacts (SaaS terms, logos, SOC-2 pointer, estimated timeline)? Amy — I'll ask you both for the HubSpot opportunity id and any high-priority logos or references you want included.

Next step: Karthik, please drop the intake and I will schedule a 30-min PDM/PSM pairing call with Vanessa and Amy (and Raj).

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic GTM | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Amy Holt <amy.holt@cloudleap.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 13:25:00 -0800
Subject: ACE intake packet & required artifacts

Hi all,

Thanks — I've attached the ACE intake PDF and a short checklist to speed things up. Required items we need from CloudLeap to submit:
- Buyer account confirmation (AWS account ID + owner contact)
- Description of joint solution and one-sentence GTM value prop for listing
- Expected ARR range and top 3 target customer logos (can be anonymized)
- SOC 2 or equivalent security attestation (link or PDF)
- Logo (SVG/PNG) and short 50-word description for marketplace listing

I've attached: ace-intake-cloudleap.pdf (ACE intake form) and noted the fields in red — if you can get those back by EOD Wed (17th) we'll submit before the end of the week.

I will also flag the opportunity in AWS once the intake is uploaded. On PSM: I can cover initial enablement and run the technical kickoff, and Vanessa will drive GTM. Vanessa — can you propose two time slots for the intro?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ace-intake-cloudleap.pdf (PDF, 155KB)]

From: Amy Holt <amy.holt@cloudleap.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

All —

Thanks — scheduled a 30-min PDM/PSM intro for Thu, Feb 18 at 10:00am PT. Calendly link: https://calendly.com/vanessa-ortiz/ace-pdm-intro (also added the meeting to everyone's calendar).

Agenda (30 min):
